main_body: upright rectangular wooden loom frame with vertical warp threads, checkered woven band, and two vertical legs
top_band: 2-row medium brown rim at rows 10-11 (under the row 9 dark outline) above a 1-row light highlight at row 12
evidence: Reading a vertical column through the middle of the loom (rows 9-25): row 9 is a 1px dark outline, rows 10-11 are only 2 rows of medium brown, and row 12 is a 1px lighter line that stretches straight across the vertical side posts as well. Both the upper beam (rows 9-12) and lower beam (rows 22-25) are drawn as thin front-facing bevelled bars with only a 1-2px top rim rather than foreshortened horizontal top surfaces.

style.evidence: The wood frame uses 4 shading steps (including the dark brown outline) arranged exclusively in unbroken ruler-straight horizontal and vertical 1-2px stripes with no wood grain or lighting variation across the span. The warp threads are uniform 1px vertical stripes and the woven cloth is a rigid 2x1 checkerboard, making the piece look mechanical and much flatter than the richly textured Beodeul stall and well references.
